description: Six-level intervention ladder. Walked top to bottom; the first level whose min_score and min_confidence are both met wins. min_confidence gates the more severe actions on more than a high score alone -- a high fused_score built from one uncorroborated source stays capped at a lower level until something else agrees. Tune here, not in code -- app.scoring.intervention just reads this file. fusion_weights blend the rule/ml/graph scores into fused_score. Both are tuned together by scripts/tune_fusion.py, and the file's hash is recorded on every RiskScore as ladder_version.
